label: Enterprise artifact repository connector
summary: Prepare a selected enterprise repository integration for explicitly typed, immutable build artifacts.
core_boundary: A generic repository service is not a generic downloader or executable package manager inside Core. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Select one provider and artifact profile with admitted repository scope, content types, sizes and immutable integrity references.
Qualify publisher provenance, dependency and license evidence independently from successful authentication or download.
Refuse arbitrary destinations and unsafe archive paths; exercise credential rotation, retention expiry and interrupted retrieval.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
